name: Flutter
description: The first clip is let go and falls like a sheet of paper: it tips back and sinks while gliding from side to side, its leading edge dipping and rising at the end of each swing, until it drops out of the bottom of the frame, casting a shadow on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: sway
params.description: Width of each swing, in frame heights

params.name: shading
params.description: Shading of the sheet and darkness of its shadow
